text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed bumps in Paul Estrela Lane, between Woodmount Avenue and Woodbine Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed bumps in Paul Estrela Lane, between Woodmount Avenue and Woodbine Avenue at the locations shown on Drawing 421G-3561 attached to the report (December 9, 2019) from the Acting Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
